citation.authors: Schubert MM, Terauds S, Plant M, Handler G, Atkins C, Mendez C
citation.title: Prior acute exercise restores postprandial fat oxidation in active cannabis users

population.description: The nonuser group only (NU, n = 11, five males; Table 1): physically active (>= 150 min MVPA per week), aged 18-50, no history of cardiovascular or metabolic disease, no medication affecting metabolism aside from birth control. The paper calls the cohort 'otherwise healthy and active' in its Discussion and ran no glucose test, so 'healthy' rests on that history screening. Age and BMI are the NU column of Table 1. The cannabis-user group (n = 11) is not entered.

protocols.name: fasted_rest_control
protocols.description: Control trial, nonusers: morning arrival (0530-0930) after an overnight fast, no exercise the day before. The fasting samples (capillary blood on arrival, then 20 min supine gas exchange, BP after 10 min of rest, HR with no time given) are entered as a one-minute window at minute 29 of a 30-minute short fasted arm, the corpus convention for a fasting sample: the paper prints no clock for them and a value at minute 0 cannot be learned from. Fast length ('overnight'), clock hour and arm length are assumed (10 h, 08:00, 30 min). No meal, water only.

protocols.name: evening_bout_60min
protocols.description: Exercise trial, nonusers: 60 min of treadmill exercise at ~100% of ventilatory threshold, reported to the laboratory 1500-1800. Intensity from the measured exercise VO2 of Table 2, column NU: 29.4 mL/kg/min; level = (29.4 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.8107. Arm starts at the bout (minute 0) and the bout runs minutes 0 to 60. The paper says nothing about food before the visit, so the arm starts from typical values (norm_center) with no meal; the clock hour (1500-1800 is a range) is assumed.

findings.description: Resting heart rate before the MTT, control trial, nonusers (Table 3 'Fasting heart rate'); the paper does not say when in the visit or how it was taken, so it is entered at minute 29 of the fasted arm.

left_out.what: Pre-exercise blood lactate (Table 2): a resting value at the start of an arm whose fed state is not printed
Exercise RER (Table 2), which depends on the unreported pre-exercise meal
Fasting values in the EX column of Table 3 (the morning after the evening bout): the evening meal and night between bout and test are not printed
Carbohydrate and fat oxidation, in g over the bout (Table 2) and in g/min fasting (Table 3)
Fat oxidation, in g over the bout (Table 2) and fasting g/min (Table 3)
Total energy expenditure of the bout in kcal (Table 2)
Fasting total, LDL and HDL cholesterol (Table 3)
Fasting mean arterial pressure (Table 3), derived from SBP and DBP

Postprandial time courses and iAUC after the milkshake test meal at 30, 60, 120, 180 min, RER, EE, oxidation, TG, glucose, cholesterol, MAP (Figures 2-6; text gives only mixed-group F tests and mean differences)
Metabolic flexibility, NU Control 0.032 and NU Exercise values (Results text): baseline RER minus mean postprandial RER
Cannabis-user group (n = 11) in Tables 1-3: cannabis use is a drug-exposure state the model cannot represent
